messages.content: What are the calories of a Big Mac?

message.content:
A standard **McDonald’s Big Mac** contains roughly **550 kilocalories** (kcal) – which is equivalent to about **2,300 joules**.  

> *Note:*  
> - Calorie counts may vary slightly depending on regional recipes or ingredient changes.  
> - If you’re looking at a “Double‑Patty” version (“Quarter Pounder”) it will have more—typically around 700–800 kcal.  
> - For an exact figure tailored to your local menu, check the official McDonald’s nutrition guide online or ask staff at the restaurant.
